summary: #smallpoems Breath paints windows In a fog of reality drafting past winds of nothingness in condensation of thought Tattered cloth brings hope of truth Memories worn into tattered threads Hide holes allowing Cold in, soul warms With each memory
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Breath paints windows
In a fog of reality
drafting past winds of
nothingness
in condensation
of thought
Tattered cloth brings
hope of truth
Memories worn
into tattered threads
Hide holes allowing
Cold in, soul warms
With each memory
